summary: Final best not confirmed: NO_PASSING_BEST. Best measured round was the unmodified seed (round 1): PARTIAL_PASS with 5/7 workloads, the two row-duplicated singular correctness inputs unmatched, and timing speedups of 6.997x / 47.638x / 24.711x at 0.172 / 0.216 / 0.931 ms (reference 1.201 / 10.279 / 23.003 ms). Diagnostics established that the reference is the CPU fallback of aten::linalg_inv_ex, which returns info=0 with finite ~1e8 entries on those inputs even though lu_factor_ex on the identical matrix finds an exactly zero pivot (info=3/7), and that this target's Triton lowering uses two roundings rather than FMA. The hypothesis that the reference factors A^T (which explains the tiny non-zero pivot and info=0) was implemented in rounds 2-3 but those candidates returned non-finite values at BLOCK_N=4/8, so correctness fell to 3/7 and no round qualified as a new best before the 3-round limit.
